items.title: Bobby Watson interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, January 19, 1996
items.q: You know Beethoven, he used a pencil.

ctx.x: So four bars of inspiration and the rest of the tune of perspiration.

That’s right. There’s only one person wrote in pen and that was Mozart. Everybody else uses pencil you know? So I have to realize that. You know Beethoven, he used a pencil. So I say hey, you know you write it, you throw it away, and you have to, it’s perspiring.

You know that’s fabulous that you have these combination of skills. Am I correct in saying that many saxophone players say that the clarinet is the more difficult instrument? And if you start on that, switching to clarinet is easier?
